entities.summary: David Campos, is a politician who is Vice Chair of the California Democratic Party. In 2008 he was elected to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, where he represented San Francisco's District 9 until 2016 when he termed out. During his tenure, Campos sought to prohibit the construction of market-rate housing in his district.
